scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Publishers for Publishing Books of Goan Authors
other_conditions: The writer of the book must be Goan
Applicant should have substantial experience in publication
Publisher must publish a minimum of 500 copies of the book for which assistance is sought
The book may be self‑published or published by another unit provided a NOC is issued by the author to the publisher
Printing and paper of the book must be of good quality and standard
Person who has lived in Goa for a minimum of 10 years of his creative lifespan is treated as Goan
benefits_summary: Up to 300 books will be purchased with total assistance not exceeding ₹50,000, and the publisher must provide at least a 15% discount on the book price.
